_comment: SEC EDGAR fair-access client settings (DSN-20261101-issuer-segment-lookthrough §2.6). Every SEC caller reads the User-Agent through scripts/lib/sec_edgar_client.py. 'contact' ships as the placeholder and is NEVER filled in this committed file (public repo): the operator sets it in the local override named by local_override_path (or the SEC_EDGAR_CLIENT_LOCAL environment variable), which is never committed. An empty, placeholder or invalid contact makes every SEC caller refuse to send; there is no fallback address.
